model.description: Device model identifier (e.g., 'AT', '6510', '5110'). Use 'AT' for generic AT-mode devices.

port.description: Device communication port (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/ttyACM0, /dev/rfcomm0, or host:port for network).

baudrate.description: Baud rate for serial connections (e.g., 9600, 19200, 115200). Ignored for non-serial connections.

smsc.description: SMS Service Center (SMSC) phone number (with '+' prefix), e.g., '+1234567890'. Leave blank to use the SIM's default SMSC.

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for SMS send/receive operations.

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 7 (debug). Higher values produce more detailed logs.

logfile.description: Path to log file. Use empty string ('') to disable file logging (logs only to stderr).

pin.description: PIN code for the SIM card (e.g., '1234'). Leave blank if no PIN is set or if PIN handling is done externally.

devices.description: List of additional devices to manage. Each entry defines a device with its own settings.

model.description: Device model identifier. If omitted, falls back to global 'model'.

connection.description: Connection type. If omitted, falls back to global 'connection'.

baudrate.description: Baud rate for serial connections (0 = use global setting or auto-detect).

pin.description: PIN code for this device's SIM. If omitted, falls back to global 'pin'.
